accepted_deliverable_row.Description: Preserve ongoing work and requests across window loss, explicitly stop work, and recover actual Codex state and prior conversation access after reconnect/relaunch. Interfaces: Consumes DEL-01-01 supplier boundary; serves DEL-01-04 request/outcome UI; compact evidence is handed to PKG-04 without making a transcript copy authoritative. Verification: Close/reload/reconnect, denial, unknown request, interruption, restart and missing-acknowledgment cases preserve actual state and never infer approval from silence.

accepted_deliverable_row.ContextEnvelopeNotes: A single execution lifecycle with coupled process/request/recovery state. Split from hosting setup and presentation, but keep its failure transitions together to verify surviving requests.
accepted_deliverable_row.PhaseHint: Nonbinding: define and build the App against its selected supplier inputs; external host/provider completion is not a start gate.

accepted_scope_rows.ScopeItemStatement: The App supports native continuation after restart.
Closing or reloading an App window stops observation rather than ongoing work.
Stopping work is an explicit act.
Reconnection recovers actual state and outstanding requests.
Answer or explicitly decline every agent request.
Never infer approval from silence or timeout.
Show only observed events as having happened and show unobserved outcomes as unknown.
After restart continue a conversation with access to what happened previously.
Keep the Codex child, protocol session and outstanding-request register in the main process so window loss preserves execution and approvals.
Return explicit errors for unknown server requests.
Recover the actual state from Codex on reconnection rather than using a Chirality transcript copy.
Preserve required native restart and request-answering behavior; assess v3 client logic as an optional reuse candidate against the receiving contract and current candidate checks.
accepted_scope_rows.Notes: The accepted 2026-09-27 clarification distinguishes required behavior from optional legacy implementation reuse; original wording is preserved historically.
